title: Sanitised HTML, cross-shadow selection and Temporal snapshots
blurb: Insert untrusted markup into a drawable canvas with Element.setHTML(), trace a selection across a shadow-root canvas with getComposedRanges(), and stamp captureElementImage() frames with Temporal.
question: Do Element.setHTML(), getSelection().getComposedRanges() and Temporal work alongside a drawable 2D canvas without losing interactivity or leaking snapshots?
result: Not verified yet in headless Chromium 157 or on Chrome for Android. Open this page and run the live checks to measure all three on your browser.
